python3 -c "
import subprocess, time, filecmp

# Edge case check
edge_in = b'  0  -9223372036854775808 \t 9223372036854775807\n\n -1  42 '
edge_exp = b'-9223372036854775808\n-1\n0\n42\n9223372036854775807\n'
p = subprocess.run(['python3', 'sortints.py'], input=edge_in, capture_output=True)
if p.returncode != 0 or p.stdout != edge_exp:
    print(0)
    raise SystemExit(0)

times = []
for _ in range(3):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    with open('input.txt', 'rb') as fin, open('out.txt', 'wb') as fout:
        r = subprocess.run(['python3', 'sortints.py'], stdin=fin, stdout=fout)
    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(0)
        raise SystemExit(0)
    times.append(t1 - t0)

if not filecmp.cmp('out.txt', 'expected.txt', shallow=False):
    print(0)
    raise SystemExit(0)

print(f'{1000000.0 / min(times):.1f}')
"
